content: An inch of time is an inch of gold, but ten thousand ounces of gold cannot buy back an inch of time.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Yi cun guang yin yi cun jin (一寸光阴一寸金) — Tang Poetry & Folk Wisdom
explanation: You can lose a fortune in business and reclaim it through industrious labor. But the sixty seconds you spent mindlessly scrolling, gossiping, or ruminating over trivia are vanished into eternity. Treat your hours with greater jealousy than your coin.
practicalInsight: Ruthlessly audit your calendar today. Cut out one wasteful, draining commitment and reclaim that hour for contemplation.
reflectionPrompt: If your remaining hours were measured in gold coins, how carefully would you spend today?
